policy: Candidates are independently registered; no inference or training is permitted until candidate-specific legal authorization, a compatible runtime, and hardware qualification are recorded.

candidates.hardware_requirement: NVIDIA H100 80GB, GB200 or B200-class GPU; vendor validates BF16 on 1x H100 80GB
candidates.notes: 3B active parameters do not mean a 3B-parameter checkpoint; the full 30B model still requires high-memory GPU execution. Do not route to the standard CPU runner.

candidates.hardware_requirement: 4x H100 or 2x GB200 for BF16 reference deployment
candidates.notes: The published BF16 deployment requires multi-GPU hardware. This candidate must remain out of CPU inference jobs until a legitimate free compatible runtime is available.

candidates.hardware_requirement: The official Q4_K_M GGUF file is 6.18 GB; CPU memory, disk and runtime compatibility must be measured before use.
